body:
FIX ROUND 2 (B-HC11-120 via B-HC10-120, agent 120) — growth-project-mobile#369 @ a2bfe2fa906ff5e3b991613a6838a82456db920c

Fixes Sol **B-369-2** ([Sol H7 verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/369#issuecomment-5998888199)). Opus APPROVE 0/0/2 at `3252ec79` ([Opus H7 verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/369#issuecomment-5999043389)) has no A/B; C-369-4 and C-369-5 are not on the B-369-2 lines and stay follow-ups. Base unchanged: `agent115/wear-split-6-retire-samsung` @ `1266038cd311f3dcfd8e472c04e3241a3061866b`. Delta from `3252ec79`: 3 commits, fast-forward.

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (failing before → passing after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-369-2: a Connect grant write already running when sign-out starts goes on after the immediate SecureStore revocation, creates a new authority (or uses a session read before sign-out) and binds a grant to it, so an app exit before the chain's second revocation keeps consent after a restart | `src/services/health/onDeviceState.ts`: `serialWrite` hands the write a `current()` check on the sign-out epoch. `recordLocalAuthorization` calls it after the session read, after a session write, after the authority read, after an authority creation, and with no await between the check and the grant write. A write in flight at sign-out rejects with `OnDeviceSessionChangedError` before it can create consent; the chain still waits for its native step and still revokes the authority again (an authority created while sign-out began binds no grant and is removed there) | test `46488f5c94b8e7d3ce86be0f1faae70e656c0bb6`, fix `ab92040ae2b0d39d36481a605246ff3e0f789b90`, test update `a2bfe2fa906ff5e3b991613a6838a82456db920c` | `onDeviceState.authorityStore.test.ts` `it.each` over Sol's two interleavings (session read, authority creation); the restart snapshot is taken while the chain's second revocation is held. Both fail at `46488f5c` ([lane 37344884167](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37344884167)) and pass at `a2bfe2fa` ([lane 37345713886](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37345713886)) |

**Changed existing tests (behaviour change, end state unchanged).**
- `onDeviceState.authorityStore.test.ts`: the round-1 case "a grant write in flight that starts a new authority after the first revocation is revoked again in the chain" asserted that the in-flight grant reached disk, which is the B-369-2 path. Replaced by the two cases above.
- `onDeviceState.signOutDrain.test.ts`: "a grant write in flight at sign-out ..." now expects the write to reject as stopped; the sweep still waits behind the native write and no key or grant is left. It was the only failure in PR CI at `ab92040a` ([run 37344991768](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37344991768)).

**Probe replay** (76 specs before, 77 after: every PR suite, the 20 prior probe files from B-HC9-119 lane `63ba3726`, Opus H7-120 probes, Sol H7-120 probe, plus one `.hc11` copy). Before `46488f5c` + probes: 852 pass / 7 fail ([lane 37344884167](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37344884167)). After `a2bfe2fa` + probes: 862 pass / 5 fail, all by design ([lane 37345713886](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37345713886)).

| Lens | Probe | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sol H7-120 | `authActions.interruptedAuthority.sol120`: interrupted signOut at session read / at authority creation | fail / fail (B-369-2 reproduced) | pass / pass |
| Sol H7-120 | same file: one AsyncStorage mutation outage; getAllKeys / removeMany rejection; two restart controls; held native write with clearUserCache / clearAllStorage / no rejection; in-flight and queued grant then same-account login; settled control; rejected grant / progress controls | pass | pass |
| Sol earlier | `authActions.storageOutage.sol119g`, `onDeviceState.failedGrantChain.sol119f`, `authActions.restartGrant.sol119f`, `authActions.restartOriginal.sol119f`, `onDeviceState.progressSession.sol119g`, `useWearableConnections.sol118` / `.sol119` / `.transportSol119`, `disconnectRetry.sol119`, `ConnectionsScreen.sol118`, `ConnectionsScreen.emptyImport.probe`, `WearablesShell.settingsReturn.probe`, `audit364.samsungRetirement.hc4` | pass | pass |
| Sol H6-118 | `audit364.samsungRetirement` original SAMSUNG_HEALTH expectation | fail (by design, `.hc4` copy passes) | fail (same) |
| Opus H7-120 | `onDeviceState.opus120` (11), `authActions.opus120` (5), `onDeviceCopy.opus120` (1, DOCUMENTS C-369-5) | pass | pass |
| Opus earlier | `onDeviceState.opus119e`, `useWearableConnections.opus119` / `.opus119d`, `hcPrivacyTemplate.opus119`, `healthConnectRationale.opus118`, `ConnectionsScreen.samsungRow.opus118` | pass | pass |
| Opus H46F | `onDeviceState.opus119f` DOCUMENTS C-362-14 / C-362-15 | fail (by design since H7; flipped copy passes) | fail (same) |
| Opus H46F | `onDeviceState.opus119f` and `.opus119f.flipped` "CLOSED C-362-12: a grant write in flight at sign-out leaves no key and no grant" | pass | fail on `await Promise.all([writing, retired])` only: the in-flight write now rejects as stopped (B-369-2). Lane copy `onDeviceState.opus119f.hc11` expects the rejection and keeps both end-state assertions (no key, no grant): pass |

**Money list self-check**
- Webhook order/redelivery: not touched (local consent state only).
- Concurrency and lock order: grant writes and sign-out share the one storage chain; the sign-out epoch is now checked after every await of a grant write; the immediate authority revocation stays outside the chain, the second one stays first in it.
- Terminal states: sign-out never rejects; a write in flight at sign-out ends rejected as stopped; nothing creates consent after sign-out starts.
- Pagination/fail-closed completeness: unchanged; an absent or unreadable session or authority authorizes nothing.
- Currency/minor units: not touched.
- Copy truth: no copy changed.

**Pre-push checklist**
- No free-form text or PII to logs or Sentry: no logging added.
- Identity re-checked after awaits before state writes: this is the fix (epoch after every await, right before each write).
- Cancellation races tested: sign-out during the session read, during the authority creation, and during a held native write (sweep waits).
- Copy rules: no copy.
- Failing-before test per finding: B-369-2 cases fail at `46488f5c`, pass at `a2bfe2fa`.
- Size: 1,250+/20- = 1,270 changed lines, under the 1,500 new-PR limit; production 179 lines in 2 files.

**Follow-ups (C), not changed:** C-369-2, C-369-3 (Sol), C-369-4, C-369-5 (Opus), C-362-5.

PR CI at `a2bfe2fa906ff5e3b991613a6838a82456db920c`: Typecheck, lint, test **success** ([run 37345688498](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37345688498)). Analyze absent on the stacked base, as for H1-H7.

READY FOR AUDIT
